description_target.target_text: Treat each nonzero non-wall cell as a seed color. Fill every reachable empty cell with the color of the seed that is closest by shortest path around the wall cells 5. Ties stay 0.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define dir8-deltas (list (list -1 -1) (list -1 0) (list -1 1)
                              (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)
                              (list 1 -1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1)))
    (define (flat grid) (apply append grid))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (py-bbox obj) (list (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))
    (define (py-bb< a b)
      (cond [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
            [(not (= (second a) (second b))) (< (second a) (second b))]
            [(not (= (third a) (third b))) (< (third a) (third b))]
            [else (< (fourth a) (fourth b))]))
    (define (obj-py-bb< a b) (py-bb< (py-bbox a) (py-bbox b)))
    (define (obj-color< a b) (< (obj-color a) (obj-color b)))
    (define (obj-width-gallery< a b)
      (cond [(not (= (obj-w a) (obj-w b))) (< (obj-w a) (obj-w b))]
            [(not (= (obj-h a) (obj-h b))) (< (obj-h a) (obj-h b))]
            [else (lex-grid< (crop-obj g a) (crop-obj g b))]))
    (define (lex-list< a b)
      (cond [(empty? a) (not (empty? b))]
            [(empty? b) #f]
            [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
            [else (lex-list< (rest a) (rest b))]))
    (define (lex-grid< a b) (lex-list< (flat a) (flat b)))
    (define (crop-obj grid obj)
      (let* ((r0 (obj-r1 obj)) (c0 (obj-c1 obj))
             (h (obj-h obj)) (w (obj-w obj)))
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)])
                  ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
          (set-cell out (- (first p) r0) (- (second p) c0)
                    (at grid (first p) (second p))))))
    (define (crop-py-bb grid bb)
      (subgrid grid (first bb) (third bb) (second bb) (fourth bb)))
    (define (paste-crop grid crop r0 c0)
      (for*/fold ([out grid])
                 ([r (in-range (rows crop))]
                  [c (in-range (cols crop))])
        (let ((v (at crop r c)) (rr (+ r0 r)) (cc (+ c0 c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid)))
              (set-cell out rr cc v)
              out))))
    (define (transform-by-key grid key)
      (cond [(= key 1) grid]
            [(= key 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= key 3) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= key 4) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= key 5) (flip-ud grid)]
            [(= key 6) (rotate-ccw grid)]
            [else grid]))
    (define (positions-of-color grid color)
      (filter (lambda (p) (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) color))
              (grid-positions grid)))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (let* ((r0 (obj-r1 obj)) (r1 (obj-r2 obj)) (c0 (obj-c1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c2 obj)))
        (and (= (obj-color obj) 5)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
                       (or (= r r0) (= r r1) (= c c0) (= c c1))))
                   (obj-cells obj))
             (all? (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 5))
                   (append
                    (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r0 c))
                    (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r1 c))
                    (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c0))
                    (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c1)))))))
    (define (frame-bbs grid)
      (sort (map py-bbox (filter rect-frame? (objects grid 0))) py-bb<))
    (define (bb-border-cells bb)
      (let ((r0 (first bb)) (r1 (second bb)) (c0 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (remove-duplicates
         (append
          (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r0 c))
          (for/list ([c (in-range c0 (+ c1 1))]) (list r1 c))
          (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c0))
          (for/list ([r (in-range r0 (+ r1 1))]) (list r c1))))))
    (define (floor-half n)
      (if (< n 0)
          (- (quotient (+ (- n) 1) 2))
          (quotient n 2)))
    (define (center-in-rect grid crop bb)
      (let* ((r0 (first bb)) (r1 (second bb)) (c0 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
             (top (+ r0 (floor-half (- (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (rows crop)))))
             (left (+ c0 (floor-half (- (+ 1 (- c1 c0)) (cols crop))))))
        (paste-crop grid crop top left)))
    (define (normalize-crop grid) (crop-to-content grid 0))
    (define (hole-count grid obj)
      (topo-count-holes grid obj 0))
    (define (palette-by-hole-count n)
      (cond [(= n 0) 2]
            [(= n 1) 3]
            [(= n 2) 4]
            [(= n 3) 6]
            [else 9]))
    (define (drop-last xs)
      (if (or (empty? xs) (empty? (rest xs)))
          (list)
          (cons (first xs) (drop-last (rest xs)))))
    (define (center-of-py-bb bb)
      (list (quotient (+ (first bb) (second bb)) 2)
            (quotient (+ (third bb) (fourth bb)) 2)))
    (define (pad-to-same a b)
      (let* ((h (max (rows a) (rows b)))
             (w (max (cols a) (cols b)))
             (aa (paste-crop (empty-grid h w 0) a (quotient (- h (rows a)) 2) (quotient (- w (cols a)) 2)))
             (bb (paste-crop (empty-grid h w 0) b (quotient (- h (rows b)) 2) (quotient (- w (cols b)) 2))))
        (list aa bb)))
    (define (portal-map grid colors)
      (map (lambda (color) (list color (positions-of-color grid color))) colors))
    (define (portal-dest grid portal-data pos)
      (let* ((v (at grid (first pos) (second pos)))
             (entry (find-first (lambda (row) (= (first row) v)) portal-data)))
        (if (and entry (= (length (second entry)) 2))
            (let ((a (first (second entry))) (b (second (second entry))))
              (if (equal? pos a) b a))
            pos)))
    (define (bfs-segment grid start goal wall-colors portal-data)
      (let ((prev (make-hash))
            (seen (make-hash))
            (fuel-limit (* (rows grid) (cols grid) 6)))
        (define (neighbors cur)
          (filter values
                  (map (lambda (d)
                         (let ((rr (+ (first cur) (first d)))
                               (cc (+ (second cur) (second d))))
                           (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                    (not (member? (at grid rr cc) wall-colors)))
                               (portal-dest grid portal-data (list rr cc))
                               #f)))
                       cardinal-deltas)))
        (define (rebuild cur acc)
          (if (eq? cur #f) acc (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons cur acc))))
        (hash-set! prev start #f)
        (hash-set! seen start #t)
        (let bfs ([queue (list start)] [fuel fuel-limit])
          (cond [(or (empty? queue) (<= fuel 0)) #f]
                [(equal? (first queue) goal) (rebuild goal (list))]
                [else
                 (let* ((cur (first queue))
                        (next-queue
                         (for/fold ([q (rest queue)]) ([n (in-list (neighbors cur))])
                           (if (hash-has-key? seen n)
                               q
                               (begin
                                 (hash-set! seen n #t)
                                 (hash-set! prev n cur)
                                 (append q (list n)))))))
                   (bfs next-queue (- fuel 1)))]))))
    (define (bfs-path grid start goal wall-colors portal-colors waypoints)
      (let ((portal-data (portal-map grid portal-colors)))
        (let loop ([targets (append waypoints (list goal))] [cur start] [full (list start)])
          (if (empty? targets)
              full
              (let ((seg (bfs-segment grid cur (first targets) wall-colors portal-data)))
                (if (not seg)
                    #f
                    (loop (rest targets) (first targets) (append full (rest seg)))))))))
    (define (gallery-top crops)
      (if (empty? crops)
          (list (list 0))
          (let* ((h (apply max (map rows crops)))
                 (w (+ (apply + (map cols crops)) (max 0 (- (length crops) 1)))))
            (let pack ([remaining crops] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
              (if (empty? remaining)
                  out
                  (let ((crop (first remaining)))
                    (pack (rest remaining) (+ left (cols crop) 1)
                          (paste-crop out crop 0 left))))))))
    (define (geodesic-distance grid start goal wall-color)
      (let ((queue (list (list (first start) (second start) 0)))
            (seen (make-hash))
            (found #f))
        (define (search)
          (unless (or (empty? queue) found)
            (define cur (first queue))
            (set! queue (rest queue))
            (define p (list (first cur) (second cur)))
            (define d (third cur))
            (if (equal? p goal)
                (set! found d)
                (begin
                  (for ([delta (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                    (define rr (+ (first p) (first delta)))
                    (define cc (+ (second p) (second delta)))
                    (define np (list rr cc))
                    (when (and (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                               (not (= (at grid rr cc) wall-color))
                               (not (hash-has-key? seen np)))
                      (hash-set! seen np #t)
                      (set! queue (append queue (list (list rr cc (+ d 1)))))))
                  (search)))))
        (hash-set! seen start #t)
        (search)
        found))

    (let* ((seeds (filter values
                          (map (lambda (p)
                                 (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                                   (if (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5))) (list (first p) (second p) v) #f)))
                               (grid-positions g)))))
      (for*/fold ([out g])
                 ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                  [c (in-range (cols g))])
        (if (not (= (at g r c) 0))
            out
            (let* ((dist-rows
                    (filter values
                            (map (lambda (s)
                                   (let ((d (geodesic-distance g (list (first s) (second s)) (list r c) 5)))
                                     (if d (list d (third s)) #f)))
                                 seeds)))
                   (mind (if (empty? dist-rows) #f (apply min (map first dist-rows)))))
              (if (not mind)
                  out
                  (let* ((nearest (filter (lambda (x) (= (first x) mind)) dist-rows))
                         (colors (remove-duplicates (map second nearest))))
                    (if (= (length colors) 1)
                        (set-cell out r c (first colors))
                        out)))))))
  ))
